title: ze_Castlevania
description:
Map by Luffaren (STEAM_0:1:22521282)

===============
As the prophecy states, the time has come once again...
Every hundred years, the dark vampire known as Dracula resurrects.
His power and minions spreads far, and terrorizes the land into turmoil.

Enter, the Belmont bloodline!
A vampire hunter named Simon Belmont must venture into the Count's domain in order to defeat him.
Your mission is to aid Simon in his holy quest against the evil that now stands before you.
Along the way you will have to encounter numerous challenges and dangers, but even then you must stay vigilant.
Follow Simon into the depths of darkness, slay the evil that lurks there to free the land.
Good luck!
===============
